The grading quorum of 5 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an attacker cannot sit on the panel that judges it. Shards are assigned from the marble graph, which means cluster membership directly reduces grading power. A farm of 1593 identities would post 3533 proofs and burn roughly 42 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted.
